spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
Players == {"pa", "pb"}
Insts == {"i1", "i2"}
Guardians == {"g1", "g2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, phase, prop, votes

vars == <<owner, phase, prop, votes>>

Vote == {"yes", "no"}
Phases == {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = [i \in Insts |-> "idle"]
    /\ prop  = [i \in Insts |-> [slot |-> NONE, player |-> NONE]]
    /\ votes = [i \in Insts |-> [g \in Guardians |-> NONE]]

\* An instance opens a two-phase round for a free slot, but only if no other
\* instance is already voting on the same shared-pool slot.
Propose(i, s, p) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ \A j \in Insts : (j # i /\ phase[j] = "voting") => prop[j].slot # s
    /\ prop'  = [prop  EXCEPT ![i] = [slot |-> s, player |-> p]]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "voting"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = [g \in Guardians |-> NONE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Cast(i, g, v) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ votes[i][g] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i][g] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, prop>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ \A g \in Guardians : votes[i][g] = "yes"
    /\ owner[prop[i].slot] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop[i].slot] = prop[i].player]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes>>

Abort(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ \E g \in Guardians : votes[i][g] = "no"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, prop, votes>>

Reset(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ prop'  = [prop  EXCEPT ![i] = [slot |-> NONE, player |-> NONE]]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = [g \in Guardians |-> NONE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Quiesce ==
    /\ \A i \in Insts : phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Insts, s \in Slots, p \in Players : Propose(i, s, p)
    \/ Quiesce
    \/ \E i \in Insts, g \in Guardians, v \in Vote : Cast(i, g, v)
    \/ \E i \in Insts : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Insts : Abort(i)
    \/ \E i \in Insts : Reset(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Players \cup {NONE}]
    /\ phase \in [Insts -> Phases]
    /\ votes \in [Insts -> [Guardians -> Vote \cup {NONE}]]

\* Two instances sharing one pool never run concurrent voting rounds on the
\* same slot, so the pool can never grant that slot to two players at once.
NoConflict ==
    \A i, j \in Insts :
        (i # j /\ phase[i] = "voting" /\ phase[j] = "voting")
            => prop[i].slot # prop[j].slot

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoConflict
nl:
Two independent matchmaking-lobby instances share a single pool of game slots.
To place a party into a slot, an instance runs a two-phase commit: its coordinator
proposes assigning a specific free slot to a specific player, every guardian of the
pool casts a yes/no vote, and the round commits only on a unanimous yes while the
slot is still free. Because both instances draw from the same pool, an instance may
open a voting round on a slot only when no other instance is already voting on that
same slot. A round can also abort if any guardian votes no, and after a commit or
abort the instance resets its coordinator back to idle before starting another round. When the shared pool is fully allocated the instances simply idle.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Two instances never run concurrent voting rounds on the same shared slot, so the pool never allocates one slot to two players at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m3p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"c1", "c2"}
Runways == {"r1", "r2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTerm == 3

VARIABLES term, isLeader, ldrTerm, owner, capacity

vars == <<term, isLeader, ldrTerm, owner, capacity>>

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ isLeader = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ ldrTerm  = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ owner    = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]
    /\ capacity = 1

\* Failover: a controller wins a fresh election, bumping the term and becoming
\* the sole leader; every other controller's leader flag is cleared, so any
\* controller still flagged leader from an older term becomes stale.
Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ isLeader' = [m \in Nodes |-> m = n]
    /\ ldrTerm'  = [ldrTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, capacity>>

\* Only the authorized, non-stale leader (flagged and at the current term) may
\* assign a free runway, and only while capacity has not been reached.
Grant(n, r) ==
    /\ isLeader[n]
    /\ ldrTerm[n] = term
    /\ owner[r] = NONE
    /\ Cardinality({x \in Runways : owner[x] # NONE}) < capacity
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = n]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, isLeader, ldrTerm, capacity>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ owner[r] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, isLeader, ldrTerm, capacity>>

\* Available runway capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
ChangeCapacity(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..Cardinality(Runways)
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, isLeader, ldrTerm, owner>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, r \in Runways : Grant(n, r)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Release(r)
    \/ \E c \in 1..Cardinality(Runways) : ChangeCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ isLeader \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ ldrTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ owner \in [Runways -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ capacity \in 1..Cardinality(Runways)

\* No stale controller stays active: any controller still flagged as leader must
\* be leading the current term, so a failed-over (stale) leader can never act.
NoStaleLeader ==
    \A n \in Nodes : isLeader[n] => ldrTerm[n] = term

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleLeader
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator is run by a set of controllers that elect a single
leader. Leadership is versioned by a monotonically increasing term: when a controller
fails over it wins a fresh election, which bumps the term and makes that controller the
sole leader while clearing every other controller's leader flag, so any controller still
marked leader from an earlier term is now stale. Only the authorized, non-stale leader --
the one currently flagged as leader at the present term -- may grant a free runway to
an aircraft, and only while the runway capacity in force has not been reached. Runways
can be released back to the free pool, and the available capacity is reconfigured at
runtime between one and the number of physical runways.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller still flagged as the leader must be leading the current term, so a stale, failed-over leader can never perform an allocation.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m3p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Insts == {"i1", "i2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES leaderInst, epoch, reserver, launches

vars == <<leaderInst, epoch, reserver, launches>>

Init ==
    /\ leaderInst = NONE
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ reserver = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ launches = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

\* Failover election: one instance becomes the single authorized leader for the
\* shared slot pool, superseding whoever led before.
Elect(i) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ leaderInst' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserver, launches>>

\* The current leader reserves a free, not-yet-launched slot for its instance.
Reserve(i, s) ==
    /\ leaderInst = i
    /\ reserver[s] = NONE
    /\ launches[s] = 0
    /\ reserver' = [reserver EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderInst, epoch, launches>>

\* Firing a takeoff clearance is irreversible: only the leader that holds the
\* reservation may fire, and only a slot that has never been launched.
Fire(i, s) ==
    /\ leaderInst = i
    /\ reserver[s] = i
    /\ launches[s] = 0
    /\ launches' = [launches EXCEPT ![s] = launches[s] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderInst, epoch, reserver>>

\* An un-launched reservation can be released back to the shared pool.
Release(s) ==
    /\ reserver[s] # NONE
    /\ launches[s] = 0
    /\ reserver' = [reserver EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderInst, epoch, launches>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : launches[s] = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Insts : Elect(i)
    \/ \E i \in Insts, s \in Slots : Reserve(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Insts, s \in Slots : Fire(i, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaderInst \in Insts \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ reserver \in [Slots -> Insts \cup {NONE}]
    /\ launches \in [Slots -> 0..2]

\* The irreversible takeoff clearance fires at most once per shared slot, even
\* though two independent instances draw takeoffs from the same pool.
AtMostOnceLaunch ==
    \A s \in Slots : launches[s] <= 1

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOnceLaunch
nl:
Two independent runway-allocator instances share a single pool of departure slots.
Leadership over the pool is decided by failover election: an instance wins an election
and becomes the sole authorized leader, superseding whoever led before. The current
leader may reserve a free, not-yet-launched slot for its instance, and it may then fire
the takeoff clearance for a slot it holds -- an irreversible one-time action that may
only be applied to a slot that has never been launched. A reservation that has not yet
been fired can be released back to the shared pool. Once every slot has been launched
the system idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible takeoff clearance fires at most once per shared slot, even though two instances draw from the same pool.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m5p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Runways == {"r1", "r2"}
Quorum == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES authorized, inbox, proposal, granted

vars == <<authorized, inbox, proposal, granted>>

Init ==
    /\ authorized = Controllers
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ proposal = NONE
    /\ granted = [r \in Runways |-> NONE]

\* A controller is re-admitted to the authorized set at runtime.
Authorize(c) ==
    /\ c \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, proposal, granted>>

\* A controller is de-authorized (becomes stale); any vote it had already cast
\* for the live proposal is purged so it can never count.
Deauthorize(c) ==
    /\ c \in authorized
    /\ Cardinality(authorized) > Quorum
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {c}
    /\ inbox' = {m \in inbox : m.voter # c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, granted>>

\* Open a quorum vote on a free runway.
Propose(r) ==
    /\ proposal = NONE
    /\ granted[r] = NONE
    /\ proposal' = r
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, granted>>

\* Only a currently authorized controller may cast a vote; votes accumulate in an
\* unordered set and may be tallied in any order.
Vote(c) ==
    /\ proposal # NONE
    /\ c \in authorized
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.voter = c
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[voter |-> c]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, proposal, granted>>

Commit ==
    /\ proposal # NONE
    /\ Cardinality(inbox) >= Quorum
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![proposal] = "granted"]
    /\ proposal' = NONE
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED authorized

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Authorize(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Deauthorize(c)
    \/ \E r \in Runways : Propose(r)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Vote(c)
    \/ Commit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ authorized \subseteq Controllers
    /\ inbox \subseteq [voter : Controllers]
    /\ proposal \in Runways \cup {NONE}
    /\ granted \in [Runways -> {NONE, "granted"}]

\* Every vote counted toward the live quorum comes from a currently authorized
\* controller, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever influences a grant.
OnlyAuthorizedVotes ==
    \A m \in inbox : m.voter \in authorized

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedVotes
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator commits each runway grant only after a quorum of
controllers vote for it. Controller membership changes at runtime: a controller can be
re-admitted to the authorized set, or be de-authorized and become stale. When a controller
is de-authorized, any vote it had already cast for the live proposal is immediately purged
so that it can never count toward quorum. A grant round begins by proposing a free runway;
only a currently authorized controller may cast a vote, and because votes travel over an
unordered fabric they accumulate in a set and may be tallied in any order. Once a quorum of
votes has accumulated the runway is granted and the round closes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every vote counted toward a live quorum comes from a currently authorized controller, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever influences a grant.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od8m2p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Parts == {"p1", "p2"}
Courses == {"co1", "co2"}
Students == {"st1", "st2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTxid == 3

VARIABLES txid, phase, acks, seats, pending

vars == <<txid, phase, acks, seats, pending>>

Phases == {"idle", "prepare", "committed", "aborted"}

Init ==
    /\ txid = 0
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ acks = {}
    /\ seats = [c \in Courses |-> NONE]
    /\ pending = [course |-> NONE, student |-> NONE]

\* Begin a fresh 2PC transaction on a free seat: a new transaction id is issued
\* and the acknowledgement tally is purged, discarding any leftover acks.
Begin(c, s) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ seats[c] = NONE
    /\ txid < MaxTxid
    /\ txid' = txid + 1
    /\ phase' = "prepare"
    /\ acks' = {}
    /\ pending' = [course |-> c, student |-> s]
    /\ UNCHANGED seats

\* A participant may be slow but not failed: it acknowledges whenever it is ready,
\* always stamping the acknowledgement with the current transaction id.
Ack(p) ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ ~ \E m \in acks : m.voter = p
    /\ acks' = acks \cup {[voter |-> p, txid |-> txid]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txid, phase, seats, pending>>

CommitTxn ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ \A p \in Parts : \E m \in acks : m.voter = p /\ m.txid = txid
    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![pending.course] = pending.student]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txid, acks, pending>>

AbortTxn ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txid, acks, seats, pending>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ pending' = [course |-> NONE, student |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txid, acks, seats>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ (txid = MaxTxid \/ \A c \in Courses : seats[c] # NONE)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Courses, s \in Students : Begin(c, s)
    \/ \E p \in Parts : Ack(p)
    \/ CommitTxn
    \/ AbortTxn
    \/ Reset
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ txid \in 0..MaxTxid
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ acks \subseteq [voter : Parts, txid : 0..MaxTxid]
    /\ seats \in [Courses -> Students \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pending \in [course : Courses \cup {NONE}, student : Students \cup {NONE}]

\* The live acknowledgement tally holds only acks stamped with the current
\* transaction, so no stale participant's leftover ack is ever counted.
AllAcksCurrent ==
    \A m \in acks : m.txid = txid

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AllAcksCurrent
nl:
A university course-registration system seats a student into a course only after a
two-phase commit across its participants. Each registration begins a fresh transaction:
a new transaction id is issued and the acknowledgement tally is purged, discarding any
leftover acknowledgements from a prior transaction. Participants may be slow but never
fail: a participant acknowledges whenever it is ready, always stamping its acknowledgement
with the current transaction id. The transaction commits, seating the student, only when
every participant has acknowledged the current transaction; otherwise it may abort. After
a commit or abort the coordinator resets to idle. When every seat is filled the system idles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The live acknowledgement tally holds only acknowledgements stamped with the current transaction, so no stale participant's leftover ack is ever counted.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m1p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Cranes == {"k1", "k2", "k3"}
Stacks == {"sa", "sb"}
Total == 3

NextCrane == [k1 |-> "k2", k2 |-> "k3", k3 |-> "k1"]

VARIABLES holder, stacks, waiting, adminHeld

vars == <<holder, stacks, waiting, adminHeld>>

Init ==
    /\ holder = "k1"
    /\ stacks = [s \in Stacks |-> IF s = "sa" THEN 2 ELSE 1]
    /\ waiting = {}
    /\ adminHeld = FALSE

\* A crane requests the ring token.
Request(c) ==
    /\ c \notin waiting
    /\ holder # c
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, stacks, adminHeld>>

\* The token holder passes it to the next crane around the ring.
Pass ==
    /\ holder \in Cranes
    /\ ~ adminHeld
    /\ holder' = NextCrane[holder]
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {NextCrane[holder]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stacks, adminHeld>>

\* Only the exclusive token holder may move a container from one stack to another;
\* nothing is created or destroyed in the transfer.
Move(from, to) ==
    /\ holder \in Cranes
    /\ from # to
    /\ stacks[from] > 0
    /\ stacks' = [stacks EXCEPT ![from] = stacks[from] - 1, ![to] = stacks[to] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, waiting, adminHeld>>

\* Privileged admin override: the yard admin seizes the token from any crane.
AdminSeize ==
    /\ ~ adminHeld
    /\ adminHeld' = TRUE
    /\ holder' = "admin"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stacks, waiting>>

\* The admin hands the token back to a crane.
AdminRelease(c) ==
    /\ adminHeld
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ adminHeld' = FALSE
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED stacks

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Request(c)
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E from, to \in Stacks : Move(from, to)
    \/ AdminSeize
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : AdminRelease(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Cranes \cup {"admin"}
    /\ stacks \in [Stacks -> 0..Total]
    /\ waiting \subseteq Cranes
    /\ adminHeld \in BOOLEAN

\* Containers are conserved: the two stacks always hold exactly the original
\* total between them, so no move ever creates or destroys a container.
Conservation ==
    stacks["sa"] + stacks["sb"] = Total

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A container-ship crane yard coordinates its cranes with a single token that circulates
around a ring; only the crane currently holding the token has exclusive access to move
containers. A crane may request the token, and the current holder passes it to the next
crane around the ring. The exclusive holder may move one container from one stack to
another, a transfer that neither creates nor destroys any container. A privileged yard
admin can override the ring at any time, seizing the token from whichever crane holds it,
and later hands the token back to a chosen crane. While the admin holds the token no crane
may pass it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The stacks always hold exactly the original total number of containers between them, so no move ever creates or destroys a container.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m1p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Robots == {"rb1", "rb2", "rb3"}
NextRobot == [rb1 |-> "rb2", rb2 |-> "rb3", rb3 |-> "rb1"]

VARIABLES holder, inAisle, waiting, adminHeld

vars == <<holder, inAisle, waiting, adminHeld>>

Init ==
    /\ holder = "rb1"
    /\ inAisle = {}
    /\ waiting = {}
    /\ adminHeld = FALSE

Request(r) ==
    /\ r \notin waiting
    /\ holder # r
    /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inAisle, adminHeld>>

\* The current holder may pass the token onward only after leaving the aisle.
Pass ==
    /\ holder \in Robots
    /\ ~ adminHeld
    /\ inAisle = {}
    /\ holder' = NextRobot[holder]
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {NextRobot[holder]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inAisle, adminHeld>>

\* Only the authorized token holder may enter the exclusive aisle, and only when
\* it is empty.
Enter(r) ==
    /\ holder = r
    /\ inAisle = {}
    /\ inAisle' = {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, waiting, adminHeld>>

Exit(r) ==
    /\ r \in inAisle
    /\ inAisle' = inAisle \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, waiting, adminHeld>>

\* Privileged admin override: the admin seizes the token and forcibly clears the
\* aisle of any robot occupying it.
AdminSeize ==
    /\ ~ adminHeld
    /\ adminHeld' = TRUE
    /\ holder' = "admin"
    /\ inAisle' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED waiting

AdminRelease(r) ==
    /\ adminHeld
    /\ holder' = r
    /\ adminHeld' = FALSE
    /\ waiting' = waiting \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED inAisle

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Request(r)
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Enter(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Exit(r)
    \/ AdminSeize
    \/ \E r \in Robots : AdminRelease(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Robots \cup {"admin"}
    /\ inAisle \subseteq Robots
    /\ waiting \subseteq Robots
    /\ adminHeld \in BOOLEAN

\* No unauthorized or stale robot occupies the exclusive aisle: any robot in the
\* aisle must be the current token holder.
OnlyHolderInAisle ==
    \A r \in Robots : r \in inAisle => r = holder

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyHolderInAisle
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet coordinates access to a single exclusive aisle with a token that
circulates around a ring of robots. A robot may request the token, and the current holder
passes it to the next robot around the ring -- but only after it has left the aisle, so it
is never stale-in-aisle when it hands the token off. Only the authorized token holder may
enter the exclusive aisle, and only while the aisle is empty; a robot in the aisle later
exits. A privileged warehouse admin can override the ring at any time, seizing the token
and forcibly clearing the aisle of any robot occupying it, and later hands the token back
to a chosen robot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any robot occupying the exclusive aisle must be the current token holder, so no unauthorized or stale robot ever operates in the aisle.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m2p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Books == {"b1", "b2"}
Patrons == {"pa", "pb"}
Branches == {"br1", "br2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES inCirc, lock, phase, pending, votes

vars == <<inCirc, lock, phase, pending, votes>>

Vote == {"yes", "no"}
Phases == {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}

Init ==
    /\ inCirc = Books
    /\ lock = [b \in Books |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ pending = [book |-> NONE, patron |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [br \in Branches |-> NONE]

\* Capacity changes at runtime: a book is withdrawn from or returned to circulation.
Reconfigure(b) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ IF b \in inCirc THEN inCirc' = inCirc \ {b} ELSE inCirc' = inCirc \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, phase, pending, votes>>

\* Open a 2PC reservation round for a circulating, currently-unheld book.
Propose(b, p) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ b \in inCirc
    /\ lock[b] = NONE
    /\ pending' = [book |-> b, patron |-> p]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [br \in Branches |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCirc, lock>>

CastVote(br, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[br] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![br] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCirc, lock, phase, pending>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A br \in Branches : votes[br] = "yes"
    /\ lock[pending.book] = NONE
    /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![pending.book] = pending.patron]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCirc, pending, votes>>

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Rxs == {"rx1", "rx2"}
Pharms == {"ph1", "ph2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

    /\ leaseEpoch = [rx \in Rxs |-> 0]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ dispensed = [rx \in Rxs |-> NONE]

\* A pharmacist acquires a free lease on a prescription.
Acquire(ph, rx) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[rx] = NONE
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![rx] = ph]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseEpoch, inbox, dispensed>>

\* The lease holder issues a dispense command, stamped with the current lease
\* generation; commands travel over an unordered channel (a set).
Request(ph, rx) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[rx] = ph
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.rx = rx /\ m.ph = ph /\ m.epoch = leaseEpoch[rx]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[rx |-> rx, ph |-> ph, epoch |-> leaseEpoch[rx]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseEpoch, dispensed>>

\* The lease expires: the generation advances, the holder is cleared, and every
\* outstanding command for that prescription -- now stale -- is purged.
Expire(rx) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[rx] # NONE
    /\ leaseEpoch[rx] < MaxEpoch
    /\ leaseEpoch' = [leaseEpoch EXCEPT ![rx] = leaseEpoch[rx] + 1]
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![rx] = NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {m \in inbox : m.rx # rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED dispensed

\* A lease is released normally: the holder is cleared and its outstanding
\* commands are purged (the generation is unchanged).
Release(rx) ==
    /\ leaseHolder[rx] # NONE
    /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![rx] = NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {m \in inbox : m.rx # rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseEpoch, dispensed>>

\* A command is applied, in any order, only if it matches the current lease
\* generation and holder; delivering it dispenses the prescription.
Deliver(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.epoch = leaseEpoch[m.rx]
    /\ leaseHolder[m.rx] = m.ph
    /\ dispensed[m.rx] = NONE
    /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![m.rx] = m.ph]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseEpoch>>

    \/ \E ph \in Pharms, rx \in Rxs : Acquire(ph, rx)
    \/ \E ph \in Pharms, rx \in Rxs : Request(ph, rx)
    \/ \E rx \in Rxs : Expire(rx)
    \/ \E rx \in Rxs : Release(rx)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Deliver(m)

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseHolder \in [Rxs -> Pharms \cup {NONE}]
    /\ leaseEpoch \in [Rxs -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ inbox \subseteq [rx : Rxs, ph : Pharms, epoch : 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ dispensed \in [Rxs -> Pharms \cup {NONE}]

\* its prescription's current lease holder and generation.
AllRequestsCurrent ==
    \A m \in inbox : leaseHolder[m.rx] = m.ph /\ m.epoch = leaseEpoch[m.rx]

When a lease expires, its generation advances, the holder is cleared, and every outstanding
command for that prescription -- now stale -- is purged. A lease may also be released normally, which clears the holder and purges its outstanding commands. A command is applied only if it
still matches the prescription's current lease holder and generation, and delivering it
dispenses the prescription.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every outstanding dispense command matches its prescription's current lease holder and generation, so no unauthorized or stale command is ever acted on.

    /\ inCS = {}

    /\ coarseOwner = NONE
    /\ coarseOwner' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineOwner, inCS, panelState>>

    /\ fineOwner = NONE
    /\ fineOwner' = c

    /\ fineOwner = c
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ inCS' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, panelState>>

Operate(c) ==
    /\ c \in inCS
    /\ panelState' = IF panelState = "locked" THEN "unlocked" ELSE "locked"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, inCS>>

Exit(c) ==
    /\ c \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, panelState>>

    /\ fineOwner = c
    /\ c \notin inCS
    /\ fineOwner' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, inCS, panelState>>

RelCoarse(c) ==
    /\ coarseOwner = c
    /\ fineOwner # c
    /\ coarseOwner' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineOwner, inCS, panelState>>

    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : AcqFine(c)

    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Operate(c)

    /\ fineOwner \in Ctrls \cup {NONE}

    /\ panelState \in {"locked", "unlocked"}

\* section holds both the coarse and the fine lock, so at most one is ever inside.

    \A c \in Ctrls : c \in inCS => (coarseOwner = c /\ fineOwner = c)

    /\ s \notin active
    /\ s \notin sessionReqs
    /\ sessionReqs' = sessionReqs \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, active, dispensed>>

\* A staff member opens a session; sessions persist until explicitly ended, so a
\* staff member may be slow but never fails.
OpenSession(s) ==
    /\ s \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {s}
    /\ sessionReqs' = sessionReqs \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, dispensed>>

\* Ending a session clears every reservation the departing staff member held, so
\* no stale reservation is left behind.
EndSession(s) ==
    /\ s \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {s}
    /\ reg' = [u \in Units |-> IF reg[u] = s THEN NONE ELSE reg[u]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dispensed, sessionReqs>>

\* Compare-and-swap reservation of a unit register: succeeds only if the register
\* is free (compare NONE, swap owner), and only for an active staff member.
Acquire(s, u) ==
    /\ s \in active
    /\ reg[u] = NONE
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![u] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, dispensed, sessionReqs>>

\* The current reserver dispenses a unit while its session is active.
Dispense(s, u) ==
    /\ reg[u] = s
    /\ s \in active
    /\ dispensed[u] < 2
    /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![u] = dispensed[u] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, active, sessionReqs>>

Release(s, u) ==
    /\ reg[u] = s
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![u] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, dispensed, sessionReqs>>

    \/ \E s \in Staff : OpenSession(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : EndSession(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, u \in Units : Acquire(s, u)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, u \in Units : Dispense(s, u)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, u \in Units : Release(s, u)

Ctrls == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES coarseOwner, fineOwner, inCS, crashed

vars == <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, inCS, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ coarseOwner = NONE
    /\ fineOwner = NONE
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Coarse (department) lock, acquired first by a live controller.
AcqCoarse(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ coarseOwner = NONE
    /\ coarseOwner' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineOwner, inCS, crashed>>

\* Fine (course) lock, acquired only by the live coarse-lock holder.
AcqFine(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ coarseOwner = c
    /\ fineOwner = NONE
    /\ fineOwner' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, inCS, crashed>>

\* Enter the enrollment critical section holding both locks, only when empty.
Enter(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ coarseOwner = c
    /\ fineOwner = c
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ inCS' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, crashed>>

Exit(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ c \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, crashed>>

RelFine(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ fineOwner = c
    /\ c \notin inCS
    /\ fineOwner' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, inCS, crashed>>

RelCoarse(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ coarseOwner = c
    /\ fineOwner # c
    /\ coarseOwner' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineOwner, inCS, crashed>>

\* A single controller may crash silently: it stops taking any further action but
\* keeps whatever locks and critical-section occupancy it held.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseOwner, fineOwner, inCS>>

\* The supervisor reclaims a crashed controller's locks and critical-section slot,
\* atomically clearing all of them, and the controller is replaced (recovers).
Reclaim(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ coarseOwner' = IF coarseOwner = c THEN NONE ELSE coarseOwner
    /\ fineOwner' = IF fineOwner = c THEN NONE ELSE fineOwner
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {c}
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : AcqCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : AcqFine(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Exit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : RelFine(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : RelCoarse(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Reclaim(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarseOwner \in Ctrls \cup {NONE}
    /\ fineOwner \in Ctrls \cup {NONE}
    /\ inCS \subseteq Ctrls
    /\ crashed \subseteq Ctrls

\* Mutual exclusion of the enrollment critical section: any controller inside it
\* holds both the coarse and the fine lock, even across a silent crash and its
\* reclamation, so at most one controller is ever inside.
CSHoldsBothLocks ==
    \A c \in Ctrls : c \in inCS => (coarseOwner = c /\ fineOwner = c)

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CSHoldsBothLocks

A university course-registration system protects its enrollment critical section with
hierarchical locking, coarse then fine: a single department (coarse) lock and a single course
(fine) lock. A live controller acquires the coarse lock first; only the coarse-lock holder
may then acquire the fine lock. A controller may enter the enrollment critical section only
while holding both locks and only when it is empty; it later exits, then releases the fine
lock and afterwards the coarse lock. A single controller may crash silently: it stops taking
any further action but keeps whatever locks and critical-section occupancy it held. The
supervisor then reclaims a crashed controller's locks and critical-section slot, atomically
clearing all of them together, and the controller is replaced.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller inside the enrollment critical section holds both the coarse and the fine lock, even across a silent crash and its reclamation, so at most one controller is ever inside.
